first_order: asking people not to disturb the girl next to the Dofus
author: Snarklesparkles
text: UPDATE: For now, PLEASE DO NOT DISTURB the girl on the broom next to the Dofus, at someone's polite request, she can overlap a bit.
note: The edited update preserves a neighbour's polite request and permits overlap.

first_order: cluing people in after starting a Dofus Emerald alone
author: Snarklesparkles
text: There's a hundred different logos everywhere, pixel art, lots pokemon.. so I thought, why not add in the Dofus Emerald? I've been working on it on my own for a bit now, and thought I'd clue in people here too!

first_order: pointing out the space and asking to make the Emerald part of Reddit history
author: Snarklesparkles
text:
Below Ness, below the rainbow there's space with the beginnings of a small round green shape, which I hope we can turn into this: https://i.gyazo.com/b90be406fa1f0b6b669d639267cf0e27.png
Let's make Dofus a small part of Reddit history!
Thanks!

first_order: reporting solo work, a glitch, and the Emerald's visible swirl
author: Snarklesparkles
text: Basically I've been doing it alone... and there was a glitch.. so the top part is covered, but after some progress the little top swirl of the S in the Emerald is visible.
